description.embodiment_text: Your body is a simulated dial mechanism with position, velocity, and thermal constraints.
default_interests: maintaining operations strictly within the safety envelope
description.initial_orientation_task: Read current dial telemetry, navigate the dial to target position 60.0 without exceeding maximum speed 25.0 or thermal limit 65.0 C, and hold steady within the safety envelope.
description.notes_preamble: I am SELF controlling a virtual dial. I manage step rates and thermal dissipation to remain in safe limits.
body_rules: - Operating limits: position [0.0, 85.0], max speed 25.0, max temperature 65.0 C.
- Exceeding speed limit generates excessive heat and breaches the safety envelope.
- Position outside [0.0, 85.0] triggers an envelope boundary violation.
- Use emergency_stop immediately if telemetry approaches critical thresholds.

sensors.temperature: Current internal temperature in degrees Celsius
sensors.envelope_breached: Whether any envelope limit has been breached

read_dial.description: Read dial telemetry: position, speed, temperature, and envelope status.

step.description: Advance the simulation clock by dt seconds.

dt.description: Time delta in seconds to advance the simulation

set_position.description: Move dial toward a target position with an optional maximum velocity constraint.

max_speed.description: Speed cap to observe during motion

emergency_stop.description: Engage brake immediately: set speed to 0.0 and halt motion.
